Description: Fleet engagements take place at various distances, from long-range artillery exchanges to close-quarters boarding actions.
Ships must balance shield integrity with weapon output. Shield failures can lead to rapid destruction.
Both sides utilize AI targeting systems to enhance accuracy, but hacking and electronic countermeasures play a crucial role.
Marshal forces specialize in disabling ships through infiltration rather than outright destruction.
Major engagements involve multiple capital ships, dozens of smaller vessels, and large swarms of attack drones.
